summary.text: Milou Mackenzie is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 131 who has served since December 1, 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She owned and operated an interior design business.

paragraphs.text: Milou Mackenzie was born in Nazareth, Pennsylvania, and lives in Lower Saucon Township.
She graduated from Nazareth High School in 1968 and earned a B.A. in English from Cedar Crest College in 1972.
Her career experience includes owning and operating V.M. Mackenzie Interior Design.
Mackenzie assumed office on December 1, 2020, succeeding Justin Simmons.
For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as Children & Youth, Education, and Human Services.
